title: What If You Could Never Sleep Again?
description:
One night you just... can't fall asleep. Not tired. Not even a little. Three rules: you never get tired, you never dream, and you can never switch it off.

Day one feels like a superpower. It won't stay that way.

Animated with AI-assisted artwork and narration.
